CS-006.caption:
For hours, it moved past Earth without reacting.

We thought that meant we were too small to matter.

This was the last frame before the structure changed its orientation toward Earth.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // ARCHIVE FRAME CS-006
CS-006.pinned_comment:
TRAJECTORY NOTE:

No signal was detected before this frame.

Seconds later, the object's new orientation pointed toward Earth.

CS-021.caption:
The Sun's corona outlined something that should not have been there.

A head. Shoulders. A body behind the light.

It was not crossing the Sun.

It was waiting behind it.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // ARCHIVE FRAME CS-021
CS-021.pinned_comment:
SOLAR OBSERVATION:

The silhouette remained fixed relative to the Sun while the surrounding corona changed.

Its distance is still unknown.

CS-028.caption:
For weeks, every transmission pointed outward.

Then one arrived from the opposite direction.

Not from deep space.

From directly beneath Earth.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // ARCHIVE FRAME CS-028
CS-028.pinned_comment:
SOURCE NOTE:

The signal reached the satellites from directly beneath Earth.

No cataloged object occupies that position.
